name: squish-cli
description: Resize and re-encode photos (and video, via ffmpeg) for the web - smaller files, no visible quality loss.
author: Victor Paniello

scripts.build: bun build src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cli.js --target node --external sharp && sed -i.bak '1s|.*|#!/usr/bin/env node|' dist/cli.js && rm dist/cli.js.bak && chmod +x dist/cli.js
